title: Physicochemical, polymeric and microbial modifications of wood toward advanced functional applications: a review
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,9027-9091
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00046G, Review Article
Changzhu Huang, Qin Qin, Yanbo Liu, Gaigai Duan, Peng Xiao, Yong Huang, Changtong Mei, Xiaoshuai Han, Jingquan Han, Shuijian He, Shaohua Jiang
This article reviews wood microstructure and component features, analyzes modification mechanisms, explores applications of modified wood, and suggests optimizing technologies and lowering costs to promote sustainable wood industry development.
